parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the lighter, made of stainless steel, protecting the ignition mechanism and flame area.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover and protect the internal components from dust and extinguish the flame when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge to open and close, allowing access to the ignition area.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small serrated metal component located near the top of the lighter.
parts.Functional_description: It is rotated by the thumb to create friction against the flint, generating sparks to ignite the fuel.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis when rolled by the user’s thumb.

parts.name: Connector (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The connector is a small metallic hinge or linkage part connecting the lid to the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the lid to pivot open and closed smoothly while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slightly as part of the hinge mechanism when the lid is opened or closed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, made of stainless steel, containing the fuel reservoir and ignition components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fuel, wick, and ignition system, providing the main structure for the lighter.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main grip area for the user.
